tuning_key.text: As you know we really know nothin little can be proven / A resolution requires faith in somethin
tuning_key.attribution: Chords of Truth — Lucid Principles Canon (CC BY 4.0)

context_block: You cannot prove the next second will hold you. The body keeps its beat anyway, finding its own resolution in the motion when the facts fall away.

practice.title: Feel the Pulse
practice.instruction: Place a finger on your wrist and let the throb mark time without asking what comes next.

practice.title: Outlast the Static
practice.instruction: Draw one slow breath that lasts longer than the noise, letting the exhale dissolve the need for proof.

practice.title: Press Play
practice.instruction: Press play on the Echo and let the rhythm that needs no resolution become the ground you stand on.

archetype_tunings.The Steward: Trust that the systems hold even when the operational map cannot be proven complete. Faith that your infrastructure maintains the family’s rhythm through logistical static. The pulse of home continues not because every variable is known, but because your metronomic stewardship broadcasts steadiness into the unproven ground.
